name: Burr Riggs
dateNote: He was ordained a high priest on 25 October 1831; section 75 sends him south in January 1832.
importance: Section 75 sends him with Major N. Ashley to preach in the south. He was excommunicated in 1833 and later reinstated. He marched with the Camp of Israel in 1834 and later settled in Quincy, Illinois.
connections: His companion in section 75 was Major N. Ashley.

sources.title: Burr Riggs, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 17 Apr. 1811, Oxford, Connecticut; high priest 25 Oct. 1831 at Orange; excommunicated 26 Feb. 1833 and reinstated; Camp of Israel 1834; Quincy 1839; excommunicated again 1839 and reinstated; buried in Quincy. Death year given only as 1860.
